title: Folder Icons: Styles, Sizes & Formats | Icons8
meta_description: Browse folder icons in various styles and formats. Choose the right look for your app or document interface and check licensing details.
h1: Folder Icons for Interfaces and Documents
intro: Select a folder icon that matches the visual style of your project. These graphics represent file storage and organization in digital interfaces. You can find options in different artistic approaches to fit specific design needs.

sections.heading: Visual Styles and Themes
paragraphs: Folder icons appear in flat, line, hand-drawn, and 3D styles. A flat design works well for modern mobile apps with minimal clutter. Line art suits technical documentation or clean dashboards where space is limited.

sections.heading: File Formats and Usage
paragraphs: Assets are available as vector files for scaling without quality loss. Raster images provide quick integration into fixed-size layouts. Check the format requirements of your software before selecting a download option.

sections.heading: Color and Customization
paragraphs: Some designs come in single colors while others offer full palettes. You may need to adjust the hue to match your brand guidelines. Vector formats allow you to change colors directly in your editing tool.

faq.question: Are folder icons free to use?
faq.answer: Licensing terms vary by asset; review the specific license listed on each item's page to confirm usage rights.

faq.question: Can I change the color of a folder icon?
faq.answer: Vector formats allow you to recolor elements easily, while raster images may require external editing tools.

faq.question: What size should I download for a website?
faq.answer: Choose a resolution that matches your screen layout, typically between 64x64 and 256x256 pixels for web use.

faq.question: Do these icons work for mobile apps?
faq.answer: Yes, scalable vector formats ensure clarity on high-resolution mobile screens without pixelation.

faq.question: Is attribution required for folder icons?
faq.answer: Check the license details provided with the specific icon to see if credit must be given to the creator.

faq.question: How do I find a specific folder style?
faq.answer: Use filters to narrow results by style, such as line, flat, or 3D, to locate the exact look you need.
